narrative.northStar: The Same Clip, a Sharper Suit
narrative.overview: Mid-century geometric flat illustration with Swiss-poster Oswald. One base colour plus one hard shade per form; personality through geometry and expression.
keyCharacteristics: One base + one hard shade per form

rules.name: The One Shade Rule
rules.body: Each form carries its base colour and exactly one hard-edged shade shape.

rules.name: The Socket Rule
rules.body: Eye whites sit in a Steel-shade socket behind Paper.

rules.name: The Paper Keyline Rule
rules.body: Brows and mouth carry a Paper underlay for dark wallpapers.

rules.name: The Rare Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral is tongue and eraser only.

rules.name: The Hard-Shade Rule
rules.body: Depth on the character is a second flat shape, never blur, gradient, or outline.

dos: Do keep every Flat fill solid and every form to one base plus one hard shade.
Do use Paper underlays behind Ink features near the wallpaper.
Do set UI text in Oswald.
Do keep all REQUIRED_IDS in any new skin.
Do use Marigold as the sole interactive and accent colour.
donts: Don't add gradients, filters, blur, or outline strokes to the Flat character.
Don't use Coral beyond tongue and eraser.
Don't copy Microsoft Clippy or clippy.js artwork.
Don't change Classic when editing Flat.
